"Saucony Unisex-Child Wind FST Ac Sneaker":
- "Bought for my son and the fit was perfect! Well made shoes and comfortable for my child."
- "These shoes look awesome. They are great quality and it’s so cool to have my kiddo match the brand of my shoe. These have been perfect for my super athletic kiddo!"
- "These are really nice sneakers, made of good quality material and perfect for kids daily use. I recommend. I would order half a size smaller as the fit was a little flexible."

- "These are beautiful and easy to clean. I had always problems with the Velcro of other shoes but these are made well and seem to be lasting good."
